newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Jan-Aug forestry exports off on pulp prices.
newsitem.headline: Chile Jan-Aug forestry exports off on pulp prices.

text.p: Chile's forestry exports fell to $1.3 billion in the first eight months of the year, down 20 percent from the same period last year, as the result of lower international wood pulp prices, said state forestry board CONAF.
"The element which has most influenced the slide is cellulose, where prices have fallen 37.9 percent a tonne," said CONAF in a statement.
Export volumes were down 17 percent from the January-August period last year.
Wood pulp is Chile's top forestry product, with exports totalling $550 million in the first eight months of the year, nearly 44 percent of the sector's overall exports.
Sawn wood exports totalled $124 million, followed by wood chips at $118 million, wood in planks at $72 million and newsprint, with shipments of $70 million.
